items.content_text: io.github.kikin81.atproto:compose 9.8.4 发布, Jetpack Compose helpers for the AT Protocol Kotlin SDK. Renders Bluesky post text + app.bsky.richtext.facet annotations as a correctly-styled AnnotatedString, with bullet-proof UTF-8 byte → UTF-16 char mapping. Core artifact has no Material dependency — use :compose-material3 for the Material3 default.
items.summary: io.github.kikin81.atproto:compose 9.8.4 发布, Jetpack Compose helpers for the AT Protocol Kotlin SDK. Renders Bluesky post text + app.bsky.richtext.facet annotations as a correctly-styled AnnotatedString, with bullet-proof UTF-8 byte → UTF-16 char mapping. Core artifact has no Material dependency — use :compose-material3 for the Material3 default.
